Save a manual screening decision

Source: R/assessment.R
df_save_assessment.Rd

Manual decisions are never overwritten by df_assess_batch() unless force = TRUE is used there.

Usage

df_save_assessment(
  identifier,
  decision,
  rationale = "",
  score = NULL,
  exclusion_reason = NULL,
  metawoRld_path = ".",
  reviewer = NULL
)

Arguments

identifier

Study identifier.

decision

One of the decisions allowed by the assessment schema (by default "Include", "Exclude", "Needs manual review").

rationale

Short justification.

score

Optional inclusion probability (0-1).

exclusion_reason

Optional reason for exclusion.

metawoRld_path

Project root.

reviewer

Optional reviewer name or initials.

Value

The cache file, invisibly.
